Three formats, one result

Try an error

Select Madrid Centro and Nexo Electronics. The error sample includes negative quantities and an unknown product reference. Rejection leaves inventory unchanged.

Try a duplicate

Submit the same file twice for the same warehouse and supplier. You will receive the same processing ID.

Correct the file

The correction sample is a new version; it preserves the original and updates the supplier snapshot.

Access without storage keys

Managed identities and permissions scoped to project resources.

Recoverable errors

Invalid files are rejected. Technical failures leave the job pending for retry.

Reproducible deployment

Bicep defines the resources. GitHub Actions validates the code and builds the container.

Operations and cost

Azure Monitor records executions. The web app and processor can scale down to zero instances.

Project decisions and limitations

SQL queries use DuckDB within the API. Files and statuses are stored in Blob Storage. Azure SQL and Data Factory have not been deployed. Volume is bounded for a student demo; custom files are tested locally. An enterprise version needs user authentication, retention policies and load testing based on its requirements.
